messages:
sri: Quick FYI — vuln found in ndjson-parser (CVE-2026-XXXX). Severity: moderate->high depending on exploit chain. Patching to 3.2.4 available. Need post-update validation plan.

olivia: thanks. CVE details and PR? see diff: https://github.com/redwood/ndjson-parser/commit/abcdef

mike: I'm on the delta — upgrade looks small (minor API cleanup). Concern: changes in streaming parser change backpressure; could affect latency under tail load.

jess: Any RBAC or KMS effects? We changed keyring access last week.

sri: no direct key calls in that lib, but it touches ingest path which is instrumented — audit logs must be verified. Also make sure we don't lose trace ids.

mike: propose rollout: (1) dev unit/regression, (2) staging canary at 5% traffic with dedicated metrics, (3) 1h observation window for p50/p95/p99 + error rate. If green, ramp.

olivia: agree. Add checks: audit log entries count for ingest-service, ensure no gaps. Also validate KMS decrypt latency on canary node.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/ndjson-upgrade-3.2.4 -> env=staging, target=ingest-service, weight=5%

sri: running short smoke: `curl -H "x-env: staging" https://staging.ingest.redwood.ai/health` -> looks OK

mike: running load script now. snippet:

```
k6 run - <script.js> --vus 50 --duration 2m
```

mike: initial pass: p95 up 8% (baseline 110ms -> now 119ms). error rate 0.03% (baseline 0.01%). Not huge but notable.

jess: check KV cache hit ratios and CPU on canary nodes? Might be CPU shift.

sri: KV cache hits stable. CPU +4% on parser threads only. Seems parsing overhead.

olivia: audit logs: count of ingest.log lines in last 15m unchanged. but a couple traces missing trace_id field in 6 events — looks like parse reordering causing metadata drop.

mike: rolling back small change in parser that removed metadata pass-through. I'll create hotfix PR to reintroduce trace passthru, tag as 3.2.5-rc1.

jess: KMS decrypt latency unchanged. RBAC unaffected.

sri: good catch. Action items: mike to push 3.2.5-rc1; olivia to verify audit logs and run query; jess to monitor KMS and RBAC; I'll keep canary running at 5% until fix validated.

mike: pushed PR https://github.com/redwood/ndjson-parser/pull/1234 — deployment ready.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/ndjson-3.2.5-rc1 -> env=staging, weight=5%

mike: smoke command output:

```
{"status":"ok","service":"ingest","trace_id":"abc123"}
{"status":"ok","service":"ingest","trace_id":"def456"}
```

olivia: audit query:

```
count by trace_id | since 15m
-> all traces present, no missing fields observed after rc1
```

sri: metrics: p95 back to 111ms, errors 0.01%. Good. leaving canary for 30 more minutes then ramp.

jess: setting a temporary dashboard alert: if p95 > 130ms or errors > 0.1% for 10m, page oncall.

sri: :thumbsup: Documenting steps in incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-789

mike: will prepare release notes and changelog entry about trace passthrough.

olivia: also add audit log verification to post-deploy checklist for future parser updates.

sri: thanks all. :thumbsup:
